result.instructions: Tools for Yoco, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the last 10 successful payments."; "Which orders are still open at the Main location?"; "List the refunds from last week and their status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Yoco data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run yoco_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run yoco_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run yoco_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. yoco_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: yoco_create_payment_link
tools.title: Create a payment link
tools.description: Create a payment link that a customer can pay online. The amount is in the smallest currency unit (cents for ZAR). Creates a real, payable link. Yoco API: POST /v1/payment_links/.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit (cents for ZAR), for example 25000 for R250.00.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example ZAR.

customer_reference.description: The customer's name or reference shown on the payment page.

customer_description.description: Optional description shown on the payment page.
